import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    adj = [0] * n
    for i in range(n - 1):
        u = int(data[1 + 2 * i]) - 1; v = int(data[2 + 2 * i]) - 1
        adj[u] |= 1 << v
        adj[v] |= 1 << u
    cnt = [0] * n
    for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
        start = mask & -mask
        seen = start
        frontier = start
        while frontier:
            b = frontier & -frontier
            frontier ^= b
            i = b.bit_length() - 1
            nb = adj[i] & mask & ~seen
            seen |= nb
            frontier |= nb
        if seen == mask:
            for i in range(n):
                if mask >> i & 1:
                    cnt[i] += 1
    print('\n'.join(str(c % 1000000007) for c in cnt))

main()
